title: Principal Firmware Engineer - Video Streaming & Embedded Systems
description: At Crestron Electronics, Inc we build the technology that integrates technology. We are proud to be the largest and most recognized brand in automation and control solutions, and the premier technology partner for fortune 500 businesses globally. Our products’ are integrated into new high-tech commercial buildings’ to include some of the most exciting real estate throughout the world. Our clients include Google, Microsoft, Amazon , Linked In and many others. We are the leaders in the most exciting industry in the world! Our automation and control solutions for homes and buildings allow our clients to control entire environments with the push of a button, integrating systems such as Audio Visual, Lighting, Shading, Security, Building Management Systems and HVAC to provide greater comfort, convenience and security. Overview The Principal Firmware Engineer is a senior-level technical leader responsible for the design, development, and implementation of audio/video conferencing and embedded system solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in audio/video technologies, software architecture, design patterns, and best practices, along with a proven track record of leading and mentoring teams and delivering high-quality software products on time and within budget. Responsibilities Define and drive the technical strategy, firmware architecture, and technology roadmap for audio/video conferencing and embedded systems platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. Lead and contribute hands-on to the design, development, debugging, and optimization of complex embedded firmware and system-level solutions across hardware, firmware, operating systems, networking, audio, and video subsystems to improve performance, interoperability, and end-to-end user experience. Serve as the principal technical authority for embedded systems, multimedia processing, device networking, and real-time communication technologies, providing guidance on complex technical challenges and critical design decisions. Establish and champion firmware engineering standards, design methodologies, automation practices, debugging approaches, and validation processes that improve product quality, development efficiency, and system robustness. Partner with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and Program Management to translate business objectives and customer requirements into scalable platform solutions, execution plans, and product roadmaps. Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, and root-cause analyses for complex system issues, proactively identifying technical risks, dependencies, security concerns, and reliability gaps. Evaluate emerging technologies, industry standards, and market trends in audio/video conferencing, embedded systems, networking, and real-time communications to guide innovation and strategic technology investments. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field is required Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field is preferred Embedded software development in audio/video conferencing and embedded systems Networking protocols — TCP, UDP, HTTP/S and related stack implementation Video/audio streaming protocols (RTP, RTSP) and codecs (H.264/H.265, VP9) — highly desirable Video or graphics software systems — VAAPI, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenMAX, OpenGL Embedded software development in C/C++ or Java across Linux, Android, and RTOS platforms Audio/video technologies — conferencing systems, codec pipelines, streaming architectures, and best practices Software architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards for complex embedded systems Networking protocols — TCP, UDP, HTTP and stack-level implementation for embedded systems Video/audio streaming protocols (RTP, RTSP) and codecs (H.264/H.265, VP9) and related technologies Video/graphics software systems — VAAPI, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenMAX, OpenGL Team mentorship and guidance — translating business requirements into technical specifications Problem solving, critical thinking, and communication across cross-functional teams Full software development lifecycle — requirements gathering through deployment Per applicable state requirements, the annual pay range for this position ($159,500 - $258,000) which consists of base salary (subject to performance), reflects the hiring range for candidates. Also note, an individual’s offer may vary from this range as it may be impacted by additional factors, including but not limited to the candidate's hiring location, qualifications, experience, and market factors. Crestron Electronics offers a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, 401K with company match, Paid Time Off, Holidays, On-site Amenities at NJ Headquarters & TX Facilities, Crestron Market Cafes, and Fitness Centers. At Crestron Electronics, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion drive innovation. Crestron’s success hinges on continuing to build a workforce of unique individuals whose passion inspires us to create and revolutionize industry-leading products and services. There will always be more to accomplish, and at Crestron, we believe the best way forward is together.
